name: Aquaguard Designo UTC
summary: The Aquaguard Aspire Designo UTC RO+UV is a premium under-the-counter water purifier that combines advanced 9-stage RO+UV purification with Active Copper Infusion and water-saving technology.
intro: The Aquaguard Aspire Designo UTC RO+UV is a compact under-the-counter water purifier designed to save space while delivering safe, great-tasting drinking water. It features advanced 9-stage purification, copper infusion, UV LED purification, and water-saving RO technology, making it ideal for modern kitchens.
features: Suitable for TDS up to 2000 mg/L
Handles water hardness up to 600 mg/L

rows: i-Filter, Chemi-Block, High Recovery RO, UV Reactor, Active Copper with Zinc Booster
